content.original_pngs: All 18 original PNG hashes are unchanged.
content.printed_art: All fifteen fronts, reverses, normalized source plates, titles, seeds, and source placements match the v1.0 manifest.
content.reading: The first sheet is on the right with empty space to the left. Every later opening pairs the preceding leaf's mirrored reverse on the left with the current poem on the right.
content.source_fidelity: Original glyph silhouettes and indents remain unchanged in the print assets. The wide fourteenth source keeps its original proportions.

page_turn.geometry: Two-page book, persistent mirrored verso on the left, cylindrical WebGL turn across the spine.
page_turn.gesture: Horizontal movement spans both pages, with pointer capture and frame-coalesced drawing; vertical movement adjusts the fold. Short pulls cancel, larger pulls or directional flicks complete, and corner clicks turn automatically.
page_turn.preparation: Nearby image decoding and GPU uploads occur ahead of gestures. Cached textures persist between turns, with a bounded five-leaf working set.
page_turn.animation: The right leaf bends across the spine and settles as the persistent left reverse. Automatic turns take about 960 ms. Enlarged reading changes spreads directly.
page_turn.fallbacks: Reduced-motion and unavailable-WebGL paths are reviewed in code, not separately forced in browser.

browser.navigation: Next, Previous, corner click, forward drag, backward drag, cancelled drag, ArrowRight, Home, End, numbered picker, and bookmark reload passed.
browser.closer: Both-page enlargement and navigation passed; fitting restores the spread.

performance.scope: Observed in the current preview browser; not a cross-device performance claim.

limits: No physical phone, Safari-specific, or direct-file-navigation verification was performed.
The narrow viewport override produced 325 CSS pixels; validation records the actual CSS viewport rather than the requested outer dimensions.
Sheets 02 to 15 retain descriptive image alternatives. Their working OCR is unverified and is excluded from the reader.
